headline: LOK SABHA SPEAKER EXTENDS GREETINGS ON THE EVE OF GANESH CHATURTHI
fullText:
Lok Sabha Secretariat

LOK SABHA SPEAKER EXTENDS GREETINGS ON THE EVE OF GANESH CHATURTHI

13 SEP 2026 8:30PM by PIB Delhi

Lok Sabha Speaker Shri Om Birla has extended greetings on the eve of Ganesh Chaturthi. In his message Shri Birla has said,

"Heartiest greetings on the sacred occasion of Ganesh Chaturthi, the auspicious festival dedicated to the worship of Lord Shri Ganesha, the Remover of Obstacles and the Bestower of Auspiciousness.

I pray to Lord Shri Ganesha to remove all obstacles and difficulties from everyone’s life and bless all with happiness, peace, prosperity and good health. May His divine blessings infuse renewed energy into our resolve towards the progress of the nation and the welfare of the people.

On this sacred occasion, let us resolve to move forward on the path of knowledge, wisdom and harmony.

With a spirit of universal brotherhood, may we seek the well-being, prosperity and auspiciousness of all at the feet of Gajanan, the First-Worshipped One.

Ganpati Bappa Morya"

(Release ID: 2309921)

Lok Sabha Speaker Shri Om Birla extended greetings on the eve of Ganesh Chaturthi, wishing happiness, peace, prosperity and good health, and invoking divine blessings for national progress and the welfare of the people.

- Speaker: Shri Om Birla, Lok Sabha Speaker.  
- Occasion: Eve of Ganesh Chaturthi, festival dedicated to Lord Shri Ganesha (Remover of Obstacles, Bestower of Auspiciousness).  
- Message highlights: prayers for removal of obstacles, happiness, peace, prosperity, good health; blessings for national progress and people's welfare; call to pursue knowledge, wisdom, harmony, and universal brotherhood; concludes with “Ganpati Bappa Morya”.
